import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"
sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None, header=None)
for name, df in sheets.items():
    print(f"=== Sheet: {name} (shape {df.shape}) ===")
    print(df.to_string())
    print()

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel("budget.xlsx", sheet_name="Budget", header=None)

# Expense data rows: pandas indices 10-21 (between EXPENSES header and Total Expenses row)
exp = df.iloc[10:22, [0, 2]].copy()
exp.columns = ["Category", "Amount"]
exp = exp.dropna(subset=["Amount"])

total = exp["Amount"].sum()
print(f"Grand total expenses: {total:.2f}")
print()
print("Per-category totals:")
print(exp.groupby("Category", sort=False)["Amount"].sum().to_string())
print()
print("All expense line items:")
print(exp.to_string(index=False))
